entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Five-Year Budget for Opioid Settlement Funds. The City Council adopted a resolution approving the five-year budget for opioid settlement funds. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: FY27 Virginia Opioid Abatement Authority Funds Acceptance and Appropriation. The City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating FY27 Virginia Opioid Abatement Authority funds. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: FY27 Virginia Sexual and Domestic Violence Victim Fund Grant. Council voted to adopt an ordinance accepting and approving the FY27 Virginia Sexual and Domestic Violence Victim Fund (VSDVVF) grant. Recorded vote: 7-0.

entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Jul 6, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Repeal of Gunshot Detection Sensors Encroachment. Council adopted an ordinance repealing Ordinance No. 43378-042026 in its entirety, which had previously allowed the encroachment of 'Raven' gunshot detection devices in the public right-of-way. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Opioid Abatement, HUD Action Plan, and Budget. The City Manager presented briefings regarding Opioid Abatement Authority funding, the HUD Entitlement Funds Annual Action Plan, and the May monthly budget report.
Discussion / report: Market Street Initiative and Southeast Safety Concerns. Council Member Volosin noted a pending initiative submission regarding Market Street, and Council Member Powers raised safety concerns regarding the Southeast section of the City.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6513,plainText=false)

entry.title: Public safety · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of Funding for a Drug Prosecutor. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating funding for a drug prosecutor. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Comments on Leadership Retreat, Wasena Bridge, and Emergency Preparedness. The City Manager provided updates reporting on a department directors' leadership retreat held at RoVa Labs on September 2-3, progress on the Wasena Bridge Replacement project (approximately 95% complete with reopening expected in the coming weeks), and activities for National Preparedness Month involving Emergency Management and Stormwater teams.

entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Victim Witness Program Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating the Victim Witness Program Grant from the Department of Criminal Justice Services by a 5-0 vote, with Council Member Sanchez-Jones not present when the vote was recorded. Recorded vote: 5-0.
Adopted: Virginia Department of Fire Programs Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council adopted an ordinance to accept and appropriate the Virginia Department of Fire Programs Conference and Education Assistance Grant. Recorded vote: 6-0.

entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Presentation on Collective Bargaining by Roanoke Firefighters Association. The Roanoke Firefighters Association delivered a presentation to share information on collective bargaining, presented by President and Spokesperson Todd Reighley and sponsored by Council Members Sanchez-Jones and Nash. Council received and filed the presentation.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of FY26 Safer Communities Program Grant. City Council voted 7-0 to adopt an ordinance accepting and appropriating the Roanoke FY26 Safer Communities Program Grant. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Alcohol. City Council approved the acceptance and appropriation of a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant focused on alcohol enforcement and safety. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of 2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant for Police Traffic Services. City Council adopted an ordinance accepting and appropriating a 2027 Virginia Department of Motor Vehicles highway safety grant for police traffic services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Acceptance and Appropriation of FY25 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant. City Council voted to accept and appropriate the 2025 BJA FY25 Edward Byrne Memorial Justice Assistance Grant Program. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Public Matters Follow-Up on Police Actions Regarding Trespassing, Encampments, and Food Truck. Staff reported on Roanoke Police Department follow-ups from the August 17 meeting: an Elm Avenue property was enrolled in the Trespass Bar Program with adjacent lot cleanup; campsites near 14th Street SE were notified to vacate and cleaned up; and an inquiry regarding a food truck found the operator has proper permits with no enforceable violations.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6565,plainText=false)

entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Aug 3, 2026

entry.title: Public safety · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Lead Poisoning Prevention Week Proclamation. Mayor Joseph L. Cobb presented a proclamation declaring October 25–31, 2026, as National Lead Poisoning Prevention Week to Housing Programs and Policy Manager Desi Wynter, Lead Safe Roanoke Program Manager Katie Kennedy, and attending staff.
Adopted: FY2027 DMV Highway Safety Grant Acceptance and Appropriation. City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43483-101926, accepting and appropriating the FY2027 Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Highway Safety Grant for the Roanoke Traffic Safety Awareness Campaign. Recorded vote: 7-0.
